tasks.title: Getting started - read the overview, plan and statistical review
tasks.details: About 3-4 hours including the call. docs/HOW_IT_WORKS.md (the overview), the registered plan (OSF DOI 10.17605/OSF.IO/3XT82, and prereg/ in the repository), docs/STATISTICAL_REVIEW_2026-10-24.md. Can start in February if you confirm early.

tasks.title: Practice round as second coder (pilot quarter)
tasks.details: About 45 minutes, not scored. 20 items from the Q4 2026 pilot with Paul's answers removed: mostly fix dates (open the vendor's advisory, record when the fix was released).

tasks.title: Send the reviewer the practice second-coder sheet (pilot quarter)
tasks.details: python -m snapshot.agreement sample --batch 2026Q4; send the sheet (not the weights file) and the written rules. Unscored practice; score it only to discuss on the onboarding call.

tasks.title: Onboarding call with the external reviewer
tasks.details: Walk through the repository, the hand-check rules and the second-coder sheet; answer questions; go over the practice round if done. Move the time to suit the reviewer.

tasks.title: Join the 2027 annual review
tasks.details: Video call; the one time each year the scored rules may change. Comments welcome beforehand.

tasks.title: Send the reviewer the Q1 2027 review packet
tasks.details: Once the provisional Q1 2027 report is approved: links to the report, the registered plan, prereg/DEVIATIONS.md, the data bundle and the exact code commit; the worksheet for every headline figure; the sample of hand decisions with their rules; a short review template (holds up / doesn't / would change). Ask the reviewer for a seed number and run the spot-check draw with it (three figures); send them the result. Never choose the figures.

tasks.title: Independent review of the Q1 2027 provisional report
tasks.details: About 8-12 hours. Read the provisional Q1 2027 report against the registered plan and the deviations log; spot-check three headline figures drawn at random (from a seed you choose) plus any you pick, recomputing each from its worksheet in a spreadsheet (no programming needed); look at the sample of hand decisions and their written rules. Send a short written review (two to five pages: what holds up, what doesn't, what you'd change) by 28 April. The window can move a week or two if needed; publication is 1 May.

tasks.title: Optional mid-review check-in with the reviewer
tasks.details: Answer questions; confirm the review will arrive by 28 April or agree a new date.

tasks.title: Second coder - 20 blinded items
tasks.details: About 45 minutes, one sitting, within two weeks. Paul's answers are removed; written rules cover each case. Your answers never change his; they measure agreement, published each quarter.

tasks.title: Send the second coder this quarter's blinded sample
tasks.details: python -m snapshot.agreement sample --batch <quarter>; send the coder the sheet (not the weights file), which they open in the Reviewer's Desk; scored on the 13th of the next month (second-coder-score). The pilot quarter's sheet is the practice round (2 Mar 2027).

tasks.title: Publish the external review beside the Q1 2027 final report
tasks.details: Review unedited, the author's response, the reviewer's disclosed ties and credit; archived with the release (Zenodo). Send the reviewer the link.
